facts.text: A manufacturer of heavy off-road machines for construction, mining and quarrying already sells a system that warns the operator when the machine gets too close to an object.
facts.quote: A manufacturer of heavy off-road machines for construction, mining and quarrying already sells a system that warns the operator when the machine gets too close to an object.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine manufacturer is developing a system that applies the brakes automatically if the operator does not react.
facts.quote: It is now developing a system that also applies the brakes automatically if the operator does not react.

facts.text: Prototype hardware and software for the heavy off-road machine automatic braking system will arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software will arrive in mid-2027

facts.text: Validation of the heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must finish in less than four months after prototype hardware and software arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software will arrive in mid-2027, and validation must then finish in less than four months

facts.text: The same kind of heavy off-road machine automatic braking function previously took three to four years of mostly physical testing and per-model tuning.
facts.quote: the same kind of function previously took three to four years of mostly physical testing and per-model tuning.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work across more than 100 job-site types.
facts.quote: The system must work across more than 100 job-site types

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work across more than ten operating scenarios per machine.
facts.quote: more than ten operating scenarios per machine

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work in many weather and light conditions, including rain, snow, fog, dust, dusk, darkness and glare.
facts.quote: many weather and light conditions (rain, snow, fog, dust, dusk, darkness, glare)

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work across many machine models with different sizes and sensor positions.
facts.quote: many machine models with different sizes and sensor positions

facts.text: Sensor types for the heavy off-road machine automatic braking system are not yet fixed; possibilities include camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic and other sensors.
facts.quote: the sensor types (camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic and others) are not yet fixed.

facts.text: The research ground rules required neutrality: no vendor, product or technology was to be favoured, and commercial, open-source, academic and in-house options were all to be covered.
facts.quote: neutrality (no vendor, product or technology favoured; commercial, open-source, academic and in-house options all covered)

facts.text: The research ground rules required an evidence type for each important claim: independent study or standard, vendor claim, or expert opinion.
facts.quote: an evidence type stated for each important claim (independent study or standard, vendor claim, or expert opinion)

facts.text: The research ground rules required a date for each source, with a preference for sources from 2023 or later for tools and products.
facts.quote: a date for each source with a preference for 2023 or later for tools and products

facts.text: The research ground rules required explicit reporting of failures, limits and evidence against each approach.
facts.quote: explicit reporting of failures, limits and evidence against each approach.

facts.text: The research ground rules required findings proven only for on-road vehicles to be flagged as on-road findings.
facts.quote: Findings proven only for on-road vehicles were to be flagged as such

facts.text: When information could not be found, the research ground rules required reporting "not found" rather than guessing numbers, prices or timelines.
facts.quote: where something could not be found the research was to write "not found" rather than guess numbers, prices or timelines.
